title: HEAPSORT
definition: Heapsort builds a heap and repeatedly moves the largest element to the sorted end.
realLifeExample: It is like always taking the biggest item from a structured pile and placing it into final order.

algorithm.Iterative:
1. Convert the array into a max heap.
2. Swap the root with the last unsorted element.
3. Reduce heap size.
4. Heapify the root again.
5. Repeat until sorted.
algorithm.Functions:
1. Use BUILD_HEAP to form a max heap.
2. Use HEAPIFY after each root swap.
3. Continue until the heap becomes empty.
algorithm.Recursion:
1. Build the initial heap.
2. Swap the root with the last element.
3. Recursively heapify the reduced heap.
4. Repeat until done.
